The pullback turned up from the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (−3.7% to −12%), on lighter volume, with the Jun 25 low in the same place. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−22%); a close over the wave-1 high (+26%) says wave 3 is under way.
